sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-LLM: DeepSeek LLM: Let there be answers
sources.snippet: Introducing DeepSeek LLM, an advanced language model comprising 67 billion parameters. It has been trained from scratch on a vast dataset of 2 trillion tokens in both English and Chinese. In order to foster research, we have made DeepSeek LLM 7B/67B Base and DeepSeek LLM 7B/67B Chat open source for the research community.
